scope: Read-only review of private one-shot operator; not executed by tester
checks: Input validates JSON password string and40hex revision; on-disk release stamp must match pinned input.
Requires production, debugfalse, exactHTTPSAPP_URL, fixed demoDBname+DBusername before validation/write.
Shared Password::default used; one locked active roleadmin usernameadmin row only.
Hashcast used through User save; fresh hash verified and remembertoken rotated.
Only password,remember_token,updated_at permitted to differ; all other admin fields and other account rows compared inside transaction, rollback on mismatch.
No business table writes, seeder, .env access, credential default or persistent password command.
Private handover existing regular non-symlink0600 in0700directory; same-directory temp0600; rename atomic filesystem replacement; content/mode verified.
Output contains booleans/revision/phase/errorclass only; exception message suppressed and no password/hash/token output.
limitations: DBtransaction and filesystem handover rename are sequential, not a single atomic transaction. If handover rename/verification fails after DBcommit, password is changed while private handover may remain old. Script exitsFAIL phaseprivate-handover-update; operator must reconcile using already-authorized input and not claim success.
Guard expects operator to supply the intended deployed commit; no test execution/mutation performed by reviewer.
summary: PASS for narrow authorized single-admin reset operator; report success only after both credential and private handover checks complete.
